verdict.rationale: Docusaurus has first-party document versioning: a versioning CLI snapshots the current docs directory into a new version, and versioning is pitched as keeping documentation in sync with project releases. That covers the core of publishing versioned docs. Missing for 10: evidence of the reader-facing version switcher on the site, evidence of versioning separate products/APIs independently (multi-instance docs), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
